transitions.action: dispatch one R16 task bound to exact trigger_event_id
after R16 delivery accepted/rejected, record consumed_at
archive event fields; if successful periodic strategy review reset since_last=0

hard_rules: same trigger_event_id cannot be dispatched twice
EVERY_10_CONTENT_LOCKS uses counter threshold, not chat memory
R16 cannot create/consume/reset its own trigger event
content count is idempotent by content_id; lock-version changes cannot create extra counts

content_count_idempotency.increment_rule: If event_id has never been recorded, record it once and increment content_lock_count_total and content_lock_count_since_last_strategy_review by 1.
content_count_idempotency.duplicate_rule: If event_id already exists, do not increment any counter. CONTENT LOCK V2/V3 for same content_id remains the same content count event.
